opening.quote: Good morning, Tidewell Home, my name is and Femke. How can I help today?
opening.comment: The greeting names the company and gives a name, but the agent's own name appears garbled ('my name is and Femke'), so it is unclear the agent gave their own name clearly; the first turn is ambiguous.

verification.quote: Could I take your full name an the order number or postcode?
verification.comment: The agent asked for full name plus order number or postcode before discussing the order, and the caller supplied order 639184 with name, so verification was requested before order details were shared.

understanding.quote: So you've opened uh dispute with your bank about this payment?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue (bank dispute on a payment) and did not re-ask for the order number or name already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: They'll reply to you by email within 3 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy says the Payments team replies within 2 working days, so the agent gave an incorrect timeline; also the promised case reference 'in the hour' is not supported by policy.

process_compliance.quote: Bank disputes handled by our paymentss team, so I've passed your case to them with all the details.
process_compliance.comment: The agent correctly passed the bank dispute to the Payments team without handling it, though no hold request was needed and the timeline quoted was wrong.

communication.quote: I'm sorry it got to that points, I can hear this has been uh hassle.
communication.comment: The agent acknowledged the caller's frustration and apologised politely, though the caller's name was mispronounced as 'Tom' and 'tam' in the closing.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and closed politely, but the closing misstated the next-step timeline and the name was wrong, so the confirmation of next steps was inaccurate.
